validation.method: Read-only production; apply exact edits in memory, transpile candidate TypeScript, load the resulting registry, compare criteria/other kinds and all ten protocol criteria identities. Prompt footprints intentionally differ.
validation.allThreeVariants: PASS: 3 exact unique edits each; TS syntax; unchanged anchors/headings/tables/folds/section metadata/other kinds; unchanged ten task/oracle/harness/environment identities; unchanged production source and external formats
validation.notClaimed: No candidate worktree build, full typecheck/hook, agent run or semantic quality improvement has happened. Those remain required after independent review.

sharedCandidateMutation: All candidates replace seven duplicate module manifest fill summaries with short pointers. Baseline contrasts therefore include common manifest deduplication plus the declared placement/wording change; A-versus-B is the closer placement contrast, not a pure baseline placement-only causal claim.
application: Start each variant from identical frozen production bytes. Require exactly one before occurrence per edit before replacing. No git reset. Rebuild generated directives via npm run build:directives; do not patch generated files. The future harness-freeze commit can differ, but these production file hashes must match.

allowed: Six MODULE_SKELETON guidance comments: MODULE_VISION, OVERVIEW, MODULE_USAGE_EXAMPLE, ENTITY_INVENTORY, ENTITY_SURFACES, MODULE_CONTRACTS
Seven MODULE_SECTIONS fill values: those six plus redundant MODULE_REQUIREMENTS summary
unchanged: The MODULE_REQUIREMENTS skeleton comment and canonical inheritance literal; only its redundant fill summary changes
Exact deviation/refine/breaking-change/operator-approval/Pivot Invalidation List bytes after the content recipe
All other artifact kinds and shared constants, including research guidance
The three external format bytes and section-local load timing

semanticChecklist.recipe: State what the module owns. Link to the parent scope spec and relevant sibling, parent and child modules. For the scope link use ../<scope>.spec.md at one --module segment; add ../ for every additional segment.

Show at least one fenced Mermaid or ASCII diagram of the module main flow; Inter-Module Dependencies does not replace Overview. Choose its type per formats/diagram-vocabulary.xml. Put the caption immediately below: _<one phrase>[ — <ACR>-REQ-N[, <ACR>-REQ-M]]._; include requirement IDs only for requirements illustrated.

Write a self-sufficient target-language snippet showing init/setup, happy path and minimal error path, with intent commentary. Demonstrate this module in isolation, not neighboring-module composition.

While filling this section, read ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/entity-inventory-format.xml. Create the closed Name/Type/Purpose entity inventory per ENTITY_INVENTORY_FORMAT; assign one owner to every shared file and error.

While filling this section, read ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/entity-surface-format.xml. Give a one-line summary; fold the public per-entity details in the existing details block per ENTITY_SURFACE_FORMAT.

While filling this section, read ai/directives/sdd-v2/formats/dbc-contracts.xml. Summarize the Ports/Adapters/Services defined here; fold per-operation DbC with negative behavior in the existing details block, using DBC_PORT_FORMAT and DBC_ADAPTER_FORMAT where applicable. Keep the dependency graph and Call Chain (when there are at least two abstractions) above details; caption the diagram with one phrase and optional illustrated Requirement-IDs.

Scope requirements remain scope-owned. New module refinements use module IDs and cite parent IDs, never copy/reuse parent IDs. Without narrower obligations preserve the canonical inherited-parent-ID branch; tasks/tests trace to those parent IDs.

Preserve dependency lists/graph, option binding or deferred activation, ASCII tree/File Mapping, research registration and nested href rule, decision history/folding, handoff files/stack/rules/risks and optional post-implementation insights. Their existing body/comments/other fill values remain unchanged.

Whole-file Write/removal of guidance/self-check/actual check/close; deviation record; breaking-change Risk accepted and Pivot Invalidation List; operator authority. Exact process bytes outside the owned content fragment remain unchanged.

measurement.method: UTF-8 bytes and repository countTokens approximate words/punctuation, not provider tokenizer or cumulative SDK input.
measurement.bundle: One generated module owner + one unmaterialized skeleton + actual manifest table + each external format once. Same for flat/nested before path substitution. Constant CLI wrappers and brief/parent reads excluded. Actual run telemetry is authoritative.

variants.hypothesis: Point-of-use recipes reduce owner/manifest duplication without extra reads.
